review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (HDBG pts scored, HDBG pts allowed, HDBG lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.868 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +38.6 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 643 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Penguins attack ×1.013, defense ×0.981 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 37.3 points), no bet.
